name: everyday-meals
description: Control the private household meal diary from chat.

interface.longDescription: Log, clarify, edit and copy meals for either household profile. Read calorie/macronutrient totals, meal timing, dietary-pattern scores, history and body weight; find rotating meal ideas. Connect to the existing Fly backend with the separate household token.
defaultPrompt: Log a meal for my wife.
Copy a past meal with a smaller portion.
